test_cases.name: Super Retail
test_cases.description: Verbose customer requests a quote for multiple items, providing detailed context and explanations. The request wording is intentionally verbose and includes quantity and unit details that may require review step adjustment before final quote creation.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Multiple Items – Please Advise on Pricing and Availability
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

We are preparing for an upcoming promotional event and would like to request a sales quote for several items from your catalog. To ensure we have the right quantities and units for our needs, I am providing some initial details below. Please let us know if any clarification is needed or if you recommend adjustments based on standard packaging or availability.

1. WonderWagon Bicycle – We would like to order 7 units for our display area. If there are any bulk pricing options or minimum order requirements, please include those in the quote.
2. Generic Golden T-Shirt – Please quote for 50 packs. We are assuming each pack contains multiple shirts, but if your standard unit is individual shirts, kindly adjust accordingly and let us know.
3. Soda - Medium – Requesting 24 bottles for our refreshment stand. If bottles are not the standard unit, please clarify what is typically supplied (e.g., cans, cases, etc.).

If you need any additional information or if there are recommended substitutions based on stock or packaging, please advise. We want to ensure the quote reflects the most accurate and practical units for our event.

Best regards,
Super Retail

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for toys and apparel
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several items, providing detailed context and explanations. The request is intended to be reviewed and adjusted before the final quote is generated, with the review step potentially changing quantities or units of measure.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote – Toy Sets and Apparel
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out to request a formal sales quote for a selection of items we are considering for our upcoming promotional event. To provide some context, our team is preparing for a summer campaign and we are looking to source both toys and apparel that appeal to families and children. We anticipate needing a mix of products to cover different age groups and interests.

Here is the list of items we would like quoted:

1. JoySprout Toy Car Set – We are interested in this item for our younger audience. Please quote for 12 units. If there are any bundle options or packaging variations, kindly let us know.
2. T-Shirt – We noticed there are several T-Shirts listed in your catalog (AITEM-0023, AITEM-0022, AITEM-0024, AITEM-0025). We are not sure which model would be most suitable for our event, so please advise or quote for the standard T-Shirt you typically recommend for bulk orders. We would like pricing for 50 shirts, preferably in assorted sizes if possible.
3. WonderWagon Pull-Along Train – This item seems ideal for our interactive play area. Please quote for 5 units.

If you require any additional information regarding our intended use or event details, please let me know. We appreciate your assistance and look forward to receiving your quote.

Best regards,
Larry King

test_cases.name: WonderToys Co. - Verbose Quote Request with Review Step Update
test_cases.description: A verbose, informal quote request from WonderToys Co. that will require a review step update before the final quote is generated. The initial request includes extra context and some noisy details, and the values will be adjusted during the review step.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Toys and Apparel – Please Advise
initial_turn.body:
Hi there,

Hope you’re having a great day! We’re planning for an upcoming event and need to get a quote for a few items. I’ll try to be as clear as possible, but let me know if anything needs clarification or if you have suggestions for quantities or packaging.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

- T-Shirts: We’d like to get 50 T-Shirts for our staff and volunteers. I noticed you have several T-Shirt options (AITEM-0022, AITEM-0023, AITEM-0024, AITEM-0025), but I’m not sure which would be best for a mix of adults and kids. Can you recommend the most suitable variant or let us know if we should split the order?
- JoySprout Toy Car Set: Please quote us for 10 sets. We’re thinking these would be great for our activity tables.
- WonderWagon Bicycle: We’d like 2 units for our prize giveaways. If there are any color or size options, please let us know.

If you need any more info or if there’s a better way to bundle these for pricing, just let me know. We’re flexible on quantities if it helps with bulk pricing or availability.

Best regards,
WonderToys Co.

test_cases.name: Verbose, Impatient Quote Request with Review Step Adjustment
test_cases.description: A verbose and impatient customer from Toytopia requests a quote for several items, providing excessive context and detail. The request is intentionally wordy and includes quantity and unit specifications that are likely to be adjusted during the internal review step before the final quote is generated.

initial_turn.subject: Urgent Quote Needed – Please Process ASAP
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I need a quote for the following items, and I expect this to be handled quickly. Please don't waste time with unnecessary back-and-forth. We're preparing for a big event and need to finalize our purchase as soon as possible, so accuracy and speed are critical. If you need clarification, just ask, but honestly, I expect you to get this right the first time.

Here are the items:
- WonderWagon Pull-Along Train: 12 units. We want these for our play area, so please make sure they're suitable for kids aged 3-7. If there's any difference in packaging or model, let me know, but I assume the standard version is fine.
- T-Shirt: 50 packs. We need these for staff uniforms. I don't care about the color, but make sure they're comfortable and durable. If you have sizing options, just quote the most common size. (I see several T-Shirts in your catalog, so use whichever is best for bulk orders.)
- SmartToys Building Blocks: 5 sets. These are for our activity tables. Please ensure they're the educational type, not just generic blocks.

I expect a detailed quote with all fees and shipping included. If you can't handle this quickly, let me know so I can take my business elsewhere.

Best regards,
Toytopia
